given: a SKU that holds stock at more than one location
when: the warehouse team member opens that SKU's detail view
then: the view lists one row per location where that SKU holds stock, each showing the location and quantity
architectural_notes: E2E: the SKU-detail read path, React SPA (client/) -> boundary (app/routes/, renders_via react, JSON only) -> service (app/services/) -> repository (app/repositories/) query of stock_records filtered by sku. No new persistence; reads the same table S1 writes, PI1/PI2 guarantee one well-formed row per (sku, location). Cross-cutting: the group-by-location shaping (one row per location for a sku) lives in the service, the ORM query is the repository's sole touch, the component only renders. Verified real-branch (NFR-F1-4): seed a sku across multiple locations, assert one row per location with location + quantity.
